doc.title: Epic 5 Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Defines 7 acceptance criteria for sensor capability detection, consent modal, device scanning, IndexedDB storage, forget functionality, and quick-connect list. Includes sensor_consent schema and error codes.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Feature-flagged module exposing connectBluetoothSensor(), connectSerialSensor(), disconnectSensor(id), simulateSensor(). Uses Web Bluetooth GATT for HR Service (0x180D). Consent records in IndexedDB sensor_consent store.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Abstract Web Bluetooth and Web Serial connections with clear permissions and per-device storage. Acceptance: Connecting a Polar H10 streams HR at 1 Hz; when HR exceeds threshold, app suggests calmer preset.

doc.title: Epics & Stories Backlog
doc.snippet: S5.1 - Capability Detection & Consent UI: Detects Web Bluetooth/Serial support, hides unsupported sensors; onboarding copy explains privacy; "Forget device" clears stored handles.

constraints.constraint: All implementation in single index.html file (maintaining monolithic architecture)
SensorProvider follows same pattern as PresetProvider and SessionProvider
IndexedDB extends existing database via version migration (increment version number)
Feature-flagged: Sensors disabled by default until beta validation
Use feature detection (navigator.bluetooth) not browser sniffing
Graceful degradation: App fully functional without sensors
Soft delete pattern: Set revokedAt timestamp instead of hard delete for audit trail
Modal must trap focus, respond to Escape, announce to screen readers
All buttons must have descriptive labels and proper ARIA attributes

interface.name: useSensorBridge
interface.signature: const { sensorStatus, // "idle" | "scanning" | "connecting" | "connected" | "error" connectedDevice, // { id, name, type } | null bluetoothSupported, // boolean serialSupported, // boolean error, // { code, message } | null scanForDevices, // () => Promise<void> connectBluetoothSensor, // (deviceId: string) => Promise<void> connectSerialSensor, // (port: SerialPort) => Promise<void> disconnectSensor, // () => Promise<void> forgetDevice, // (deviceId: string) => Promise<void> getConsentedDevices, // () => Promise<ConsentRecord[]> } = useSensorBridge();

interface.name: sensor_consent IndexedDB Store
interface.signature: { id: auto-increment, deviceId: string, deviceName: string, type: "bluetooth" | "serial", grantedAt: number, scopes: string[], lastConnectedAt: number | null, connectionCount: number, revokedAt: number | null }

tests.standards: Tests use Node.js with fake-indexeddb for IndexedDB operations. Test files follow naming pattern: tests/{feature}.test.js. Each test file exports runTest() helper with async/await pattern. Use assert module for assertions. Mock browser APIs (navigator.bluetooth, navigator.serial) for capability detection tests.
